## Before class

**Reading.** TBD

The opening quiz is on this reading.

## Session A · 2:05–3:15

Academic writing III — the research design paper. Structure, and what each section is for. Writing the identification section: naming your design, its assumption, and what would break it. Stating a limitation honestly without gutting the project. What a referee actually looks for — which is also how you will write your own referee report. Then reproducibility at awareness level: where files live, naming, what 'the final version' means, and when version control is worth the cost

## Session B · 3:35–4:30

Every session B opens with a ten-minute team stand-up: what you did,
what is blocked, and who does what next — in writing, submitted with
the session output.

Bring a draft. Workshop the design paper in rotation, then Milestone 2: each team presents its design and the assumption it is defending. Second peer evaluation

Your team's output is submitted before you leave.

## Due

Design paper draft, in class · Milestone 2 presentation · Peer evaluation 2 · Research design paper, end of week
